title: Source Volumetrics
description: Standalone schema for source-table volumetric profiles. Extracted from mapping_excel.schema.json#/definitions/sourceVolumetric. Validates an array of per-source-table volumetric entries that drive Day 0 sizing (estimated_size_gb), Day 1 sizing (daily_increment_size_gb), and transform optimizations (broadcast_hint).

sourceVolumetric.description: Volumetric profile for a single source table. Drives Day 0 sizing (estimated_size_gb), Day 1 sizing (daily_increment_size_gb), and transform optimizations (broadcast_hint).

source_database.description: Source database name — must match a source_database in mapping columns

source_table.description: Source table name — must match a source table in mapping columns

estimated_rows.description: Total row count of full table

estimated_size_gb.description: Approximate total storage size in GB (primary input for Day 0 worker sizing)

daily_increment_size_gb.description: Average daily delta size in GB (primary input for Day 1 worker sizing)

primary_key.description: Primary key column(s) of source table — comma-separated if composite (e.g. 'account_id, eff_start_date'). Used for repartition key selection and dedup logic.

partition_key.description: Partition key column(s) of source table (e.g. 'dw_bus_dt', 'active'). Used for partition pruning filter selection.

table_type.description: Source table type. NonTransactional_SCD2 = entity-state tables with SCD2 history (eff_start_date, eff_end_date, active); NonTransactional_SCD1 = entity-state tables with dw_lod_tmp/dw_upd_lod_tmp only (no temporal columns); Transactional = append-only event/fact tables partitioned by business date. Directly maps to source_table_type used for runtime filtering strategy.

broadcast_hint.description: True if analyst flags this as a small reference/decode table suitable for F.broadcast(). Auto-set to true if estimated_size_gb < 0.01.
